question: How does abstention from food by day lead beyond age and death?
premises: This practice affects age and death
The practitioner will go beyond death from age
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond age and death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is interpretive; it may mean overcoming or passing beyond death.
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond age and death.
